name: open-code-review
description:
Star


  

  
    
    


      
        alibaba /

      open-code-review  

    
      Fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
summary: 阿里巴巴开源的混合架构代码审查工具，结合确定性流水线与LLM Agent，提供精准的行级注释和内置多语言规则集（如NPE、线程安全、XSS、SQL注入），经阿里大规模实战验证，高效且兼容OpenAI与Anthropic。

name: colibri
description:
Star


  

  
    
    


      
        JustVugg /

      colibri  

    
      Run frontier MoE models on hardware you already own — pure C, zero deps, experts streamed from disk. Tiny engine, immense model. 🐦
summary: Colibri 是一个纯 C 语言编写、零依赖的轻量级推理引擎，能将前沿的 MoE（混合专家）大模型流式加载到普通硬件上运行，让用户无需昂贵 GPU 即可本地部署超大模型，极具实用价值。

name: VoiceStudio
description:
Star


  

  
    
    


      
        debpalash /

      VoiceStudio  

    
      VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
summary: VoiceStudio 是一个开源的、完全本地运行的 ElevenLabs 替代品，支持 646 种语言的语音克隆、语音设计、视频配音、听写、转录和有声书创作。它值得关注是因为无需联网即可实现专业级语音功能，保护隐私且完全免费。
